sql.query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(:assignmentType,':',1)<>'team' THEN 1 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') WHERE utr.userId=:adminUserId AND utr.tenantId=:adminTenantId AND utr.isActive=1) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenants ut INNER JOIN tbl_team_members tm ON tm.userTenantId=ut.id AND tm.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND tm.teamId=CAST(NULLIF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(:assignmentTeam,':',-1),'') AS UNSIGNED) AND tm.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_team_member_roles tmr ON tmr.teamMemberId=tm.id AND tmr.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_team_role_permissions trp ON trp.teamRoleId=tmr.teamRoleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=trp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='team.tasks.assign' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE ut.userId=:userId AND ut.tenantId=:tenantId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS UNSIGNED) allowed

data.message: Only a tenant Owner, tenant Admin, Team Manager or Team Leader can allocate this task.

sql.query: INSERT INTO tbl_tasks (tenantId,workflowId,workflowStageId,sourceTemplateTaskId,taskName,description,status,priority,isRequired,assignedToUserId,assignedToTeamId,assignedToRoleId,dueDate,createdByUserId) SELECT w.tenantId,w.id,ws.id,NULL,:taskName,:description,'not_started',:priority,:isRequired,(SELECT ut.userId FROM tbl_team_members member INNER JOIN tbl_user_tenants ut ON ut.id=member.userTenantId AND ut.tenantId=member.tenantId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active' INNER JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=ut.userId AND u.isActive=1 WHERE member.tenantId=w.tenantId AND member.teamId=tm.id AND member.isActive=1 AND ut.userId=NULLIF(:assignedUserId,'') LIMIT 1),CASE WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(:assignment1,':',1)='team' THEN tm.id ELSE NULL END,NULL,NULLIF(:dueDate,''),:createdBy FROM tbl_workflows w INNER JOIN tbl_workflow_stages ws ON ws.workflowId=w.id AND ws.tenantId=w.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_teams tm ON tm.id=CAST(NULLIF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(:assignment2,':',-1),'') AS UNSIGNED) AND tm.tenantId=w.tenantId AND tm.isActive=1 WHERE w.id=:workflowId AND ws.id=:stageId AND w.tenantId=:tenantId

UPDATE tbl_workflow_stages SET status=CASE WHEN status='complete' THEN 'in_progress' ELSE status END,completedDate=NULL,modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=:stageId AND workflowId=:workflowId AND tenantId=:tenantId AND :taskId>0

UPDATE tbl_workflows SET status=CASE WHEN status='complete' THEN 'in_progress' ELSE status END,completedDate=NULL,modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=:workflowId AND tenantId=:tenantId AND :taskId>0

INSERT INTO tbl_activity_log (tenantId,userId,workflowId,taskId,entityType,entityId,actionType,summary,afterJson,createdDate) SELECT :tenantId,:userId,:workflowId,:taskId,'task',:entityId,'task.created',CONCAT(:actor,' created one-off task ',:taskName),JSON_OBJECT('taskName',:taskName2,'stageId',:stageId,'priority',:priority,'teamId',NULLIF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(:assignment,':',-1),''),'dueDate',:dueDate),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM tbl_activity_types at WHERE at.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND at.activityKey='task.created' AND at.isActive=1 AND :taskId2>0 LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO tbl_notifications (tenantId,userId,workflowId,taskId,notificationType,title,message,status,channel,createdDate) SELECT t.tenantId,ut.userId,t.workflowId,t.id,'task_assigned',CONCAT('New team task: ',t.taskName),CONCAT(:actor,' assigned this task to your team.'),'unread','in_app',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM tbl_tasks t INNER JOIN tbl_team_members tm ON tm.teamId=t.assignedToTeamId AND tm.tenantId=t.tenantId AND tm.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_user_tenants ut ON ut.id=tm.userTenantId AND ut.tenantId=t.tenantId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active' WHERE t.id=:taskId AND t.tenantId=:tenantId AND ut.userId<>:actorUserId AND (t.assignedToUserId IS NULL OR ut.userId<>t.assignedToUserId)

INSERT INTO tbl_notifications (tenantId,userId,workflowId,taskId,notificationType,title,message,status,channel,createdDate) SELECT t.tenantId,t.assignedToUserId,t.workflowId,t.id,'task_assigned',CONCAT('Task assigned: ',t.taskName),CONCAT(:actor,' assigned this task to you.'),'unread','in_app',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM tbl_tasks t WHERE t.id=:taskId AND t.tenantId=:tenantId AND t.assignedToUserId IS NOT NULL AND t.assignedToUserId<>:actorUserId
